resources.string:
How to use:

1. Set the repeat interval below and save it.
2. Open Accessibility settings and enable the Screen Clicker service.
3. Come back and tap “Show / hide target”.
4. Drag the crosshair to the point you want to tap.
5. Press Start on the floating panel – the app will tap that point automatically. Press Stop to pause or ✕ to close the overlay.
Enter a number of at least %1$d ms
Enable the Screen Clicker accessibility service first
Allows Screen Clicker to automatically tap a point you choose on the screen at a configurable repeat rate. The service does not read screen content.
